placements.role: Manufactures Ethernet switching systems used in AI back-end networks.

role_evidence.claim: Dell'Oro's June 2026 release says Celestica led AI back-end network switch sales during the quarter.

business_summary: Celestica Inc. is a Canadian electronics manufacturing and design services company whose Connectivity & Cloud Solutions segment builds Ethernet switching systems for hyperscale AI back-end networks, alongside its legacy contract-manufacturing business. It sits on the networking-optics link only.

exposure_summary.narrative: Dell'Oro's June 2026 release credits Celestica with leading AI back-end network switch sales during the quarter, which is a strong, dated claim of direct exposure for a name that started as a diversified EMS/ODM manufacturer. The evidence is a market-share ranking, not a disclosed revenue percentage, so the exact share of revenue tied to AI networking remains undisclosed here.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: No revenue-exposure percentage for this chain's links is disclosed in the sources on file: the mapping role_evidence for CELESTICA carries qualitative product/operator claims, not a segment revenue split, and no data/edgar/docs/CLS.json filing is on disk this run to check for one.

latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CLS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
latest_fy.basis: Revenues for fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL.

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CLS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (12390900000 / 7250000000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CLS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 1040700000 divided by Revenues 12390900000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CLS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities 659500000 divided by net income 832500000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/CLS.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
fcf_margin.basis: Free cash flow margin: operating cash flow 659500000 less capital expenditure 201200000, divided by revenue 12390900000, all for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: data/market/CLS.json fundamentals is missing or has stale/mismatched-period data for: total_debt (absent); net debt to EBITDA cannot be computed without mixing periods or inventing a figure.

market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 34322666536.6 = SEC companyfacts diluted share count 114906818 (as of 2025-12-31) multiplied by the close 298.7 of 2026-08-28 from the repo's own market plane (data/market/CLS.json), not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CLS.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts revenue
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 34322666536.6 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 12390900000.

price_to_earnings.source_name: Upstream market store data/market/CLS.json quality.derived.market_cap over SEC companyfacts net income
price_to_earnings.basis: Market capitalization 34322666536.6 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 GAAP net income 832500000.

crowdedness_caveats: networking-optics is chain-heat CROWDED; Celestica's own stock re-rated sharply through 2025-26 alongside other AI-networking names once Dell'Oro-style rankings made the exposure visible.
Piotroski and Beneish are both NULL: data/market/CLS.json quality reports PENDING_DATA for both scores, so this profile carries no fundamentals-quality screen beyond the raw ratios computed here.

catalysts.claim: Celestica led AI back-end network switch sales during the tracked quarter per Dell'Oro's June 2026 release, direct evidence of a leadership position rather than a marginal participant.
Revenue grew from $9.65B to $12.39B fiscal-year over fiscal-year (a computed three-year CAGR of 19.6%), a growth rate well ahead of the low-margin EMS industry's historical norm.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED is a figure computed from SEC companyfacts, with the derivation named in its basis. SPECULATIVE is reserved for the reverse-DCF solve, whose discount rate and terminal growth are assumed. NULL is a field looked for and not found or unusable without mixing reporting periods, never estimated.

notes: Profiles are medium-depth reusable research. This file carries no final verdict, no entry zone and no red team; those belong to the deep-dive stage.
Data tier (T1/T2/T3) describes data availability. Opportunity tier (O1/O2/O3) describes research priority. Neither implies the other.
